source_name: Развојна банка на Северна Македонија АД Скопје (MBDP) — corporate site
why_relevant: The country's only development bank, 100% state-owned, established by special law (Закон за Развојната банка). Not a card/ATM issuer, so of low value for payments-fleet metrics, but useful as a boundary case and for state-guarantee/export-credit context; its governing law is mirrored on the NBRM site.

source_name: МБА LinkedIn / association social channels (MBA, MASIT, BCM, ОПМ Facebook)
why_relevant: Several of these bodies post statements and event outputs to social channels before or instead of their websites; ОПМ in particular is highly active on Facebook. Useful as a change-detection tripwire on association activity, not as a primary record.

Research institute supervising second-cycle economics theses and producing applied studies; a plausible host for MK-specific work on cash usage and financial inclusion, and a route to named domestic researchers.

Carries bank marketing/promotional campaigns in MK (e.g. UNI Banka x Mastercard “Paguaj dhe hyr në lojë”), which are a cheap proxy for card-issuer competitive pushes and scheme partnerships in the Albanian-speaking segment.

source_name: Coface — North Macedonia country risk file
why_relevant: Commercial risk analysis that links the size of the informal economy to the narrow tax base; a fast, regularly refreshed secondary read on how the cash economy is perceived by commercial counterparties.

source_name: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB) - North Macedonia country page and project disclosures
why_relevant: CEB lends to the Development Bank of North Macedonia and microfinance institutions (e.g. Horizonti), so its disclosures map on-lending channels and financial-inclusion funding, though it does not fund payment infrastructure directly.

source_name: EMIS company profiles - North Macedonia technology vendors
why_relevant: Commercial database with MK entity profiles, executives and financials for vendor subsidiaries (Asseco SEE DOOEL, Printec Technology DOOEL). Useful to size the local vendor footprint, though largely paywalled.

Investigative weekly; the natural venue for tender disputes, procurement irregularities and bank-supervision controversies that never appear in statistics. Named in the cell brief; existence confirmed via reference sources, but no banking/payments article was surfaced in this pass — treat as unverified for topical yield.
High-traffic portal mirroring NBRM payment/digital-channel releases; low originality but adds breadth for diffusion tracking and occasionally adds local reaction quotes.

High-traffic MK classifieds carrying lower-tier vacancies — merchant-side POS support, field technicians, agent networks — that rarely appear on bank career pages. Weak but genuinely complementary signal on acquiring/field-service capacity.

source_name: TheGlobalEconomy.com — North Macedonia ATM machines and financial indicators
why_relevant: Free, scrape-friendly re-presentation of WB/IMF MK banking and ATM indicators with ready-made country rankings; useful for quick peer-ranking checks and for spotting which MK indicators have been discontinued upstream. Derivative, so never a primary citation.

source_name: Unija.com — Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems + AML amendments briefing
why_relevant: Regional accounting/advisory group summarising the introduction of the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems together with the AML amendments — the pairing that drives both card-acceptance expansion and cash-limit tightening.
Long-running MK daily with a stable economy category URL; adds historical depth for longitudinal media monitoring of banking/payments topics.

source_name: Македонско-бугарска стопанска комора — Здружение за угостителство, хотелиерство и туризам
why_relevant: One of the few explicitly named hospitality/HORECA association pages found in local language; HORECA is the highest-cash-intensity acceptance segment and a standing complainant on card acceptance fees. Serves as an entry pointer into the hospitality actor set while a dedicated national HORECA association remains unlocated.
